app.name: WiiCam
app.long_description: Take photos with a USB camera or record silent MJPEG video. Choose 320 x 240 or 640 x 480, set a photo timer, and refresh the camera source from the menu. Requires IOS58 and an SD card to save. Supports the WC04 camera and selected UVC 1.0 MJPEG cameras. A opens the viewfinder; + changes Photo/Video; 1 changes size; Left/Right sets the timer; 2 refreshes the source. Video is limited to 60 seconds or 128 MiB. HOME saves any recording and exits.
